snippet.title: Gutterball 2 (Windows game 2004)
snippet.description:
Gutterball 2 is a 3D bowling game made by Skunk Studios.
It has very interesting, weird and eccentric maps.
Wacky is very eccentric and Iceberg is very difficult and convoluted.
